description: Pupil/Teacher Ratio numerator is total student headcount enrollment (K-12)
Pupil/Teacher Ratio denominator is total certified teacher FTE
Classroom Teacher FTE excludes instructional specialists isolating the Specialist Denominator Wedge
Structural macro staffing ratio relates to actual class size through the schedule planning multiplier phi
Individual course section enrollments aggregate to student-weighted or class-weighted class size
Reported and derived from NCES CCD Non-Fiscal School and LEA universe files
Reported directly as student membership headcount (MEMBER) in CCD non-fiscal survey
Reported directly as total teacher FTE (TEACHERS_FTE) in CCD non-fiscal survey
Reported as distinct classroom teacher FTE in state personnel systems (KPTEN/MOSIS)
Reported as instructional paraprofessionals/aides FTE in CCD LEA survey
Reported as course section counts and enrollments in biennial CRDC waves
Direct self-reported average class size from NTPS/SASS teacher questionnaire
Federal reporting of students chronically absent (missing >= 10% school days)
IDEA Part B child count reported through EDFacts and state report cards
Students with Section 504 plans reported biennially in CRDC
Survey teacher reports and course-level sections provide empirical calibration against macro PTR
